Quest name: The Inhabitant of the Frozen Sea (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r9 Ecological Research, r11 Biology, ARC(Far North Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Greenland shark discovery (from "The Sluggish Shark" quest) + Narwhal discovery (from "A unicorn's horn" quest)
